verdict.rationale: Signifyd is an API-driven SaaS fraud platform, so issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only says the REST API docs explain how to authenticate. Nothing in the pack shows scoped keys, permission-limited tokens, or per-agent credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
